title: 发布与变更日志 Agent
markdown:
# 发布与变更日志 Agent

发布变更日志（Changelog）是工程团队最普遍的"总是来不及写、写了也不好"的文档。手写 changelog 要求工程师在发布前汇总多个 PR 的变更描述，这项工作枯燥、容易遗漏，且质量高度依赖 PR 描述的完整程度。

AI Agent 在这个场景的优势明确：从结构化的 PR 数据、commit 历史、issue 关联中自动提取变更信息，按语义归类（新功能/修复/破坏性变更/内部重构），生成面向不同受众的发布说明。

本文覆盖变更日志自动生成的数据流设计、Conventional Commits 的 AI 增强处理、以及面向用户和面向开发者的双版本发布说明生成。

## 核心概念

**Conventional Commits**（约定式提交）是 commit 信息的结构化规范，格式为 `type(scope): subject`（如 `feat(auth): add OAuth2 support`）。Changelog agent 依赖这一规范来分类变更，但现实中大量 commit 不遵循规范，agent 需要具备从不规范 commit 中推断语义的能力。

**语义归类**（Semantic Classification）指将多样化的代码变更按用户可感知的类别归类：Added（新功能）、Changed（行为变更）、Fixed（缺陷修复）、Removed（功能移除）、Security（安全相关）、Deprecated（废弃通知）。这是 Keep a Changelog 规范的核心。

**双受众发布说明**（Dual-Audience Release Notes）指同一个发布版本生成两份内容：面向最终用户的产品发布说明（聚焦"对我有什么影响"）和面向开发者的技术变更日志（聚焦"什么变了、如何迁移"）。

## 变更日志生成的数据流

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    TAG[创建 Release Tag] --> COLLECT[收集变更数据]

    COLLECT --> PR_DATA[PR 列表\n+ 描述 + 标签]
    COLLECT --> COMMIT_DATA[Commit 历史\n+ 规范分析]
    COLLECT --> ISSUE_DATA[关联 Issue\n+ 里程碑数据]

    PR_DATA --> PREPROCESS[数据预处理\n过滤内部 PR / 合并重复]
    COMMIT_DATA --> PREPROCESS
    ISSUE_DATA --> PREPROCESS

    PREPROCESS --> CLASSIFY[AI 语义归类\nAdded / Fixed / Changed / Security / Breaking]
    CLASSIFY --> DRAFT[生成草稿]

    DRAFT --> USER_NOTES[面向用户的发布说明]
    DRAFT --> DEV_NOTES[面向开发者的技术变更日志]

    USER_NOTES --> REVIEW_GATE{人工审查}
    DEV_NOTES --> REVIEW_GATE
    REVIEW_GATE -->|批准| PUBLISH[发布到 GitHub Release / 文档站]
```

## 数据收集：从 PR 到结构化变更集

```javascript
// scripts/changelog-collect.mjs
async function collectReleaseDiff(fromTag, toTag, repo) {
  const octokit = new Octokit({ auth: process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN });

  // 获取两个 tag 之间合并的所有 PR
  const { data: comparison } = await octokit.repos.compareCommits({
    ...repo,
    base: fromTag,
    head: toTag,
  });

  const mergedPRs = await Promise.all(
    comparison.commits
      .filter((c) => c.commit.message.startsWith('Merge pull request'))
      .map(async (c) => {
        const prNumber = extractPRNumber(c.commit.message);
        const pr = await octokit.pulls.get({ ...repo, pull_number: prNumber });
        return {
          number: pr.data.number,
          title: pr.data.title,
          body: pr.data.body,
          labels: pr.data.labels.map((l) => l.name),
          author: pr.data.user.login,
          merged_at: pr.data.merged_at,
          linked_issues: extractLinkedIssues(pr.data.body),
        };
      }),
  );

  // 过滤内部 / 基础设施 PR（不应出现在用户可见的 changelog）
  return mergedPRs.filter((pr) => !pr.labels.some((l) => ['internal', 'chore', 'ci', 'docs'].includes(l)));
}
```

## AI 语义归类与 changelog 生成

```javascript
const CHANGELOG_SYSTEM_PROMPT = `You are a technical writer generating release notes.

Classify each PR into one of these categories:
- ADDED: New features, new APIs, new capabilities
- CHANGED: Changes to existing functionality (not bug fixes)
- FIXED: Bug fixes, crash fixes, error handling improvements
- SECURITY: Security fixes or security-related improvements
- DEPRECATED: Features being phased out with migration path
- REMOVED: Removed features or APIs
- BREAKING: Changes that break backward compatibility

For BREAKING changes, always include a migration guide.

Then generate two versions of release notes:

1. USER_NOTES (non-technical, focus on user impact):
   - Written for end users and product stakeholders
   - Explain what changed in plain language, focusing on benefits/impact
   - Skip internal refactors, CI changes, dependency bumps
   
2. DEV_NOTES (technical changelog):
   - Written for developers integrating with or building on this software
   - Include API changes, configuration changes, deprecation notices
   - Include breaking change migration guides`;

async function generateChangelog(prs, version) {
  const prSummaries = prs.map((pr) => ({
    title: pr.title,
    description: pr.body?.slice(0, 500), // 截断过长描述
    labels: pr.labels,
    author: pr.author,
  }));

  const response = await anthropic.messages.create({
    model: 'claude-opus-4-5',
    max_tokens: 8192,
    system: CHANGELOG_SYSTEM_PROMPT,
    messages: [
      {
        role: 'user',
        content: `Version: ${version}\nPRs to include:\n${JSON.stringify(prSummaries, null, 2)}`,
      },
    ],
  });

  return parseChangelogResponse(response.content[0].text);
}
```

## 处理不规范的 Commit 信息

现实中大量 commit 不遵循 Conventional Commits 规范。Agent 需要从自由格式的 commit 信息中推断语义：

| 不规范 commit 示例                   | 推断类型     | 推断逻辑                     |
| ------------------------------------ | ------------ | ---------------------------- |
| `fixed null pointer in user service` | FIXED        | 包含 "fix" 关键词            |
| `add export endpoint for reports`    | ADDED        | 包含 "add" + 功能性描述      |
| `remove deprecated v1 API`           | REMOVED      | 包含 "remove" + "deprecated" |
| `update DB connection pool size`     | CHANGED      | 配置/参数变更                |
| `refactor auth middleware`           | 内部（跳过） | "refactor" 通常不影响用户    |
| `WIP login page`                     | 内部（跳过） | WIP 标记表示未完成           |

对于推断置信度低于 0.6 的 commit，agent 应标记为 `[REVIEW_NEEDED]`，要求人工确认分类。

## 破坏性变更的特殊处理

破坏性变更（Breaking Changes）需要特别处理，确保迁移路径清晰：

```javascript
// 检测 PR 是否包含破坏性变更
async function detectBreakingChanges(diff, prDescription) {
  const breakingSignals = [
    /BREAKING[\s-]CHANGE:/i.test(prDescription),
    /removed.*public.*api/i.test(prDescription),
    diff.includes('- export') && diff.includes('+ // removed'),
    /deprecated.*removed/i.test(prDescription),
  ];

  if (breakingSignals.some(Boolean)) {
    // 生成迁移指南
    const migrationGuide = await generateMigrationGuide(diff, prDescription);
    return { isBreaking: true, migrationGuide };
  }
  return { isBreaking: false };
}
```

破坏性变更在发布说明中必须置顶，格式示例：

````markdown
## ⚠️ Breaking Changes

### Removed: `UserService.getById()` API

**Migration Guide:**
Replace calls to `UserService.getById(id)` with `UserService.findUser({ id })`.

Before:

```typescript
const user = await userService.getById(123);
```
````

After:

```typescript
const user = await userService.findUser({ id: 123 });
```

**Why:** The old API was deprecated in v2.3.0 and has been removed to simplify the user service interface.

````

## 发布流程集成

```yaml
# .github/workflows/release-notes.yml
name: Generate Release Notes
on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'

jobs:
  release-notes:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Get Previous Tag
        id: prev-tag
        run: |
          PREV=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 HEAD^ 2>/dev/null || echo "")
          echo "tag=$PREV" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Generate Changelog
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          node scripts/generate-changelog.mjs \
            --from ${{ steps.prev-tag.outputs.tag }} \
            --to ${{ github.ref_name }} \
            --output changelog/

      - name: Create GitHub Release (Draft)
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            const fs = require('fs');
            const userNotes = fs.readFileSync('changelog/user-notes.md', 'utf8');

            await github.rest.repos.createRelease({
              ...context.repo,
              tag_name: context.ref.replace('refs/tags/', ''),
              name: `Release ${context.ref.replace('refs/tags/', '')}`,
              body: userNotes,
              draft: true,  // 草稿状态，等人工审查后发布
              prerelease: false
            });
````

关于 PR 自动化 agent 如何为变更日志提供结构化的输入数据，参见 [PR 自动化 Agent](./1_pr-automation-agents.md)。关于在运营层面管理这些 agent 的成本，参见 [成本与延迟预算](../4_operations/2_cost-latency-budgets.md)。

## 小结

发布变更日志 Agent 的核心数据流：收集 tag 区间内的 PR 集合 → 过滤内部/基础设施变更 → AI 语义归类（Added/Fixed/Changed/Security/Breaking）→ 生成双受众发布说明 → 草稿状态发布供人工审查。处理不规范 commit 是现实中最大的挑战，低置信度归类应标记为 REVIEW_NEEDED。破坏性变更必须置顶并附迁移指南。发布说明始终以草稿形式创建，人工审查批准后才正式发布，保留最终决策权。
